Details

async hoa_insights_surpriseaz.fetch_assessor_parcels.async_main(apns: list[str]) → list[dict]

Function asynchronously gathers API responses from Assessor site.

Parameters:

apns – list of APNs used as endpoint for API requests

Returns:

list of parcel API response data

hoa_insights_surpriseaz.fetch_assessor_parcels.get_parcel_apns() → list[str]

Function retrieves the Accessor Parcel Number (APN) of all parcels from database table: parcels.

Returns:

list of all APNs.

Example

APN = [“509-11-444”, “509-11-445”]

async hoa_insights_surpriseaz.fetch_assessor_parcels.get_parcel_details(client: RetryClient, sem: Semaphore, url: str) → dict

Function retrieves parcel data from the API.

Parameters:

  • client – retry client

  • sem – semaphore for tcp connection limiting

  • url – API end point suffixed with parcel APN

Returns:

parcel API data as dict

hoa_insights_surpriseaz.fetch_assessor_parcels.parcels_api() → list[dict]

Function gets the latest parcel data from Assessor API.

Returns:

list of all parcel responses from API.
